name: Metals One PLC
summary: Metals One PLC specializes in identifying and acquiring natural resource assets. The company's strategic focus is on projects involving critical battery materials, such as nickel, lithium, cobalt, and copper. Currently, its portfolio includes stakes in the Black Schist project located in Finland, as well as the brownfield Råna nickel project in Norway. Metals One PLC was established in 2021 and operates from its headquarters in London, United Kingdom.
